answer.reason: The verses give the tree's guarding after the expulsion from Eden and its fruit and leaves in the city John saw.

clauses.english: was guarded by Cherubims and a flaming sword after the man was driven out of Eden
clauses.quote: to keep the way of the tree of life

clauses.english: bore twelve kinds of fruit, and its leaves were for the healing of the nations
clauses.quote: bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month

doubts: REV 22:19 speaks of the book of life, not the tree, and REV 22:14 and REV 2:7 only promise a right to eat of it, so these were left out.
GEN 2:9 only places the tree in the garden, which the summary already says.
